changelog: Security: resolved every outstanding npm advisory across backend and frontend — 9 in total, now 0. Backend cleared brace-expansion and js-yaml (high) and undici (moderate); frontend cleared brace-expansion, js-yaml, nanoid and postcss (high).

Security: upgraded react-router to 7, closing an open-redirect via backslashes in <Link>/useNavigate and an arbitrary constructor injection in deserializeErrors(). These were the last two advisories and were fixable only by a major version bump.

The react-router upgrade is behaviour-neutral: St0r already opted into v7 semantics through the v7_startTransition and v7_relativeSplatPath future flags, which are the default in 7. The now-rejected future prop was removed.
